Denny Adan Gonzalez, a 33-year-old man from Cuba, died on April 28 at the Stewart Detention Center in rural Georgia in a suspected suicide. He is the 18th person to die in ICE custody since Jan 1. 

austinkocher.substack.com/p/…
Read the full post: austinkocher.substack.com/p/…

12,000+

The number of subscribers to this Substack, a threshold crossed just this week. Thank you to every reader who has supported this work. I still write with the same enthusiasm I had at 50 readers.

350,000

The number of Haitians who could lose work authorization and face deportation if the Supreme Court allows the Trump administration to terminate their TPS. If SCOTUS sides with the administration by June, the executive will gain near-unreviewable power to end TPS.

93%

The percentage of federal judges who have rejected ICE’s claim that it can strip immigration judges of the ability to consider immigration bonds. Federal judges have rejected ICE’s no-bond regime across the board. The 2nd Circuit just teed up a Supreme Court showdown.

505,000

The estimated number of DACA recipients whose deportation protections were weakened by a new BIA ruling. The first Trump admin tried and failed to terminate DACA outright. This time it’s chipping away at protections one ruling at a time.

258

The number of days Carlos Della Valle spent in ICE detention before being released to his wife Angela, son Alessandro, and their community of supporters.

67%

The share of the Trump admin's newly hired immigration judges who have no relevant immigration law experience listed in their public biographies. 2/3 of new judges have no immigration law experience listed in their public bios. Standard training cut from 5 weeks to 3.

The Guardian in the U.S. used to be alright. Now, it breaks stories all the time, and often publishes the most sophisticated pieces on contentious issues. Its headlines make direct statements. Versus U.S. news outlets that are so timid it can difficult to ascertain "who did what to whom?"
